text:
Ava Tran: Heads-up — running a quick mid-cycle spotcheck on submitted review forms. Goal: catch missing competencies and flag reviewers who haven't submitted by EOD Friday.
Samir Patel: thanks for the heads-up. do we have a list of folks still outstanding?
Ava Tran: yes, I pulled an export from the form portal — will share in a sec. main ask: if reviewers need more time, what's our official extension policy?
Priya Desai: default is 48h extension if manager requests via the form, otherwise escalate to L5+ people-ops. short exceptions allowed for parental leave.
Luis Gomez: how should managers request an extension? email or a form field?
Ava Tran: please use the "extension request" checkbox inside the review form (link below). that automatically opens a ticket for people-ops.
Ava Tran: https://redwood.company/forms/reviews-2026 (internal)
Samir Patel: perfect. for reviewers with heavy queues, can we reassign a backup reviewer?
Priya Desai: yes — we can assign a backup reviewer but only after manager sign-off. use this quick template in the ticket body: ``Manager: <name> | Original reviewer: <name> | Proposed backup: <name> | Reason: <brief>``
Luis Gomez: will managers get a calendar reminder? some of them forgot last cycle.
Ava Tran: People Ops Bot will send a 72h and 24h reminder to manager + reviewer. People Ops Bot: reminder schedule set for this cycle.
People Ops Bot: automated message — reminders configured: 72h before deadline, 24h before, and final ping at 6am on due date.
Samir Patel: if a reviewer submits but misses competency ratings (the free text only), what triage steps?
Priya Desai: People-ops will flag and message the reviewer first; if no response in 24h, manager will be asked to provide a provisional rating. we mark those fields as "incomplete" in the summary export.
Ava Tran: also doing a quick spotcheck sample (20% of managers) to validate calibration inputs. if we see drift we'll expand sample.
Luis Gomez: what's the escalation path for calibration conflicts?
Priya Desai: steps: 1) discussion between manager & reviewer, 2) escalate to calibration pair, 3) if unresolved, people-ops mediates and puts final recommendation to calibration panel.
Samir Patel: can you add a note about reviewer load balancing? some teams have 2 reviewers covering 40 people, which skews timelines.
Ava Tran: noted. asking eng managers to review reviewer assignments by tomorrow midday. if overload is >30 reviews per reviewer, flag for redistribution.
People Ops Bot: exported list of outstanding reviewers and workload attached to the ticket: ticket/PR-4587 (internal).
Priya Desai: drop-in office hours today 3–4pm PT for managers who want help with reassignments or extension requests.
Luis Gomez: can you confirm final deadline timezone so managers don't miss it?
Ava Tran: final submission deadline: Friday 23:59 PT (that is Sat 07:59 UTC). extensions granted per policy inline.
Samir Patel: thanks — i'll ping my managers and run the export through the manager slack channel.
Ava Tran: thanks all. will post a short checklist in the People Ops channel and follow up with the export CSV. :thumbsup:
